title: PhysicsInstanceRouteState
description: One state in a resolved reasoning route. This is the shared object: P-G authors it inside an authored instance, and the P-I hint ladder projects H1/H2/H3 from the same states rather than authoring three independent strings. `role` is an internal identifier and stays exactly as it is; the learner-facing wording comes from the governed copy registry.

canonical_role_refs.description: The P-D reasoning roles this route-state role stands for, so P-G never invents a reasoning vocabulary of its own.

input_state_refs.description: Symbols this state reads. Each must already be a given or an earlier output, which is what makes the route a state transformation rather than a list of intentions.

representation_ref.description: The teaching primitive that carries this state visually, when one does.

substitution.description: The relation with this instance's numbers put in, which is what a learner needs to see.

solution_section_ref.description: Set by P-I: which solution section projects this state, so the hint ladder and the full solution provably come from the same route.
